title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 3.23
exact_target: Can high-value sets of every normalized Green potential be covered by discs whose total radii tend uniformly to zero? Ask the same for positive harmonic functions.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2303023 (AMR-022-3023). CC BY 4.0.
Walter K. Hayman and Edward F. Lingham, \emph{Research Problems in Function Theory}, arXiv:1809.07200, 2018. Problem 3.23, its complete Update 3.23, and the relevant chapter notation.
